title: Handyman Work Request Completion Report
subtitle: Residential Handyman Work Request: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Handyman Work Request Completion Report covers room, fixture, finish, assembly, small repair, and requested improvement. The handyman service coordinator records Residential Handyman Work Request performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Handyman Work Request Completion Report keeps Residential Handyman Work Request exceptions visible until the handyman service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Handyman Work Request Completion Report at residence, room, work area, access path, and protected adjacent finish. Document room, fixture, finish, assembly, small repair, and requested improvement identity before Residential Handyman Work Request begins. Compare room, fixture, finish, assembly, small repair, and requested improvement findings with stated Residential Handyman Work Request criteria; route unresolved Residential Handyman Work Request issues to qualified trade reviewer when scope requires. For Handyman Work Request Completion Report, confirm requirements for Residential Handyman Work Request. Ask qualified trade reviewer when scope requires to review Residential Handyman Work Request conditions beyond the handyman service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Provider, customer, and service record
sections.guidance: For Residential Handyman Work Request, identify responsible parties, residence, room, work area, access path, and protected adjacent finish, and the linked room, fixture, finish, assembly, small repair, and requested improvement source.

fields.label: Dimensions, material, existing condition, and timing constraint

sections.title: Delivered result and verification evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Handyman Work Request facts for room, fixture, finish, assembly, small repair, and requested improvement; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Handyman Work Request completion checks
items: Mounting surface, substrate, support, and fastener context
Utility, moisture, structural, and concealed-condition indicators
Dimensions, fit, finish, and material match
Access, occupancy, dust, noise, and protection needs

sections.title: Completion limitation, status, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Handyman Work Request conditions; have handyman service coordinator assign the next Residential Handyman Work Request owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Electrical, plumbing, gas, structural, roofing, or hazardous-material scope
Permit or qualified trade review is required
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Handyman Work Request when scope requiring a licensed trade, permit, structural decision, or uncontrolled concealed condition remains. Retain the available Residential Handyman Work Request proof and route unresolved room, fixture, finish, assembly, small repair, and requested improvement scope to handyman service coordinator.
